label: Bible Study
prompt: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in _____ made with hands;
verse: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
note: Paul on Mars' Hill, surrounded by Athens' idols — the Creator doesn't live in buildings.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these _____; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verse: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
note: In the valley of dry bones, God promises breath — and the bones stand up as an exceeding great army.

label: Sunday School
prompt: To be taxed with Mary his _____ wife, being great with child.
verse: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
note: 'Espoused' means engaged — Mary and Joseph made the long trip to Bethlehem as a betrothed couple.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will _____ us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
verse: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
note: Nehemiah's answer to the mockers: God will prosper us, and you have no share in Jerusalem anyway.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way _____.
verse: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.
note: Follow the ark and keep your distance so you can see the way — 'for ye have not passed this way heretofore.'
